components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt tool for the main action on a vellum sheet; pressed in on use.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Start a project <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 12h15M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 14px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: var(--vellum); color: var(--graphite); box-shadow: var(--raise); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--fs-body); font-weight: 640; font-stretch: 104%; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 260ms var(--ease-out), transform 260ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; border-color: var(--cobalt); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--cobalt); color: var(--on-cobalt); box-shadow: -6px -6px 14px var(--vellum-hi), 6px 6px 16px rgba(24, 36, 143, 0.38); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-hi); border-color: var(--cobalt-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(10, 16, 80, 0.55), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(120, 136, 255, 0.45); transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: Secondary vellum tool extruded from the sheet.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-tool">See the process <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 12h15M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-tool { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 14px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: var(--vellum); color: var(--graphite); box-shadow: var(--raise); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--fs-body); font-weight: 640; font-stretch: 104%; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 260ms var(--ease-out), transform 260ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-tool svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-tool:hover { border-color: var(--graphite); } .ds-btn-tool:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-tool:active { box-shadow: var(--inset); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; border-color: var(--cobalt); }

components.name: Small Button
components.description: Compact tool, used in the docked mobile title block.
components.css: .ds-btn-small { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 1.05rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: var(--cobalt); color: var(--on-cobalt); box-shadow: var(--raise-sm); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 640; font-stretch: 104%; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 260ms var(--ease-out), transform 260ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-small:hover { background: var(--cobalt-hi); border-color: var(--cobalt-deep); } .ds-btn-small:active { box-shadow: var(--inset); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-small:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: On-Cobalt Button
components.description: White tool on the cobalt blueprint field.
components.css: .ds-cobalt-field { background: var(--cobalt); padding: 2rem; } .ds-btn-on-cobalt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 14px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: var(--on-cobalt); color: var(--cobalt-deep); box-shadow: -4px -4px 10px rgba(110, 126, 255, 0.55), 4px 4px 12px rgba(10, 16, 80, 0.5); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--fs-body); font-weight: 640; font-stretch: 104%; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 260ms var(--ease-out), transform 260ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-on-cobalt:hover { border-color: var(--cobalt-deep); } .ds-btn-on-cobalt:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-on-cobalt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--on-cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Field pressed into the vellum with a measured 3:1 resting edge.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; font-family: var(--font); color: var(--graphite); } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 640; font-stretch: 104%; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid #767a72; background: var(--vellum); color: var(--graphite); box-shadow: var(--inset); outline: none; font: inherit; caret-color: var(--cobalt); transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 260ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5d6168; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--graphite); } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--cobalt); box-shadow: var(--inset), 0 0 0 3px rgba(35, 53, 200, 0.18); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--error); }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Raised radio/checkbox chip with a hollow ring; checked presses inset.
components.css: .ds-choice { position: relative; display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 46px; padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--vellum); color: var(--graphite); box-shadow: var(--raise-sm); border: 1.5px solid transparent; font-weight: 600; transition: box-shadow 220ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-choice span::before { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--graphite-2); transition: background 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-choice input:hover + span { border-color: var(--rule); } .ds-choice input:checked + span { box-shadow: var(--inset); border-color: var(--cobalt); color: var(--cobalt-deep); } .ds-choice input:checked + span::before { background: var(--cobalt); border-color: var(--cobalt); } .ds-choice input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Well
components.description: Inset well holding an authored 1.5px-stroke cobalt icon; large raised variant on service rows.
components.css: .ds-well { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--vellum); box-shadow: var(--inset); color: var(--cobalt); } .ds-well svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-well-lg { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: var(--raise-sm); } .ds-well-lg svg { width: 34px; height: 34px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Bold link whose underline draws in from the left; trailing arrow slides on hover.
components.html: Read the standards
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 640; color: var(--graphite); text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) left bottom / 0% 1.5px no-repeat; padding-bottom: 2px; transition: background-size 420ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 1.5px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-link svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-link:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Ruled Rows
components.description: Signature: a 2px graphite head rule, then items separated by 1px hairlines on a column grid. No boxes.
components.html:
A-01FastMeasured page weight and ready time.
A-02LegibleContrast checked on every surface.
components.css: .ds-rows { border-top: 2px solid var(--graphite); font-family: var(--font); color: var(--graphite); background: var(--vellum); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5rem 1fr 2fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-row strong { font-size: var(--fs-h3); font-weight: 620; font-stretch: 106%; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-row span { color: var(--graphite-2); } .ds-row-label { font-size: var(--fs-note); font-weight: 650; font-stretch: 72%; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Index Toggle
components.description: Title block toggle that opens the cobalt drawing index; three bars spread on hover.
components.css: .ds-index-toggle { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; width: 64px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: var(--vellum); color: var(--graphite); box-shadow: var(--raise-sm); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font); transition: box-shadow 260ms var(--ease-out), transform 260ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms; } .ds-bars { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 22px; } .ds-bars i { display: block; height: 1.5px; background: currentColor; transition: transform 260ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-index-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--graphite); } .ds-index-toggle:hover .ds-bars i:first-child { transform: translateY(-1.5px); } .ds-index-toggle:hover .ds-bars i:last-child { transform: translateY(1.5px); } .ds-index-toggle:active { box-shadow: var(--inset); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-index-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-index-label { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 650; font-stretch: 72%; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Every page is a sheet in a drawing set (A-00 to A-04) laid on cool grey drafting vellum. The studio's claim that it builds properly is shown as drafting discipline: graphite line weights carry hierarchy, non-photo blue construction lines sit underneath as the drawing's scaffolding, annotation is set in condensed uppercase, and a single cobalt is reserved for action and for the blueprint. A fixed title block names the current sheet, and the menu is the set's drawing index, flooding the screen in cobalt.

The surface is calm and sparse; density comes from ruled rows, not from cards or boxes. Neumorphic extrusion exists, but only on tools a hand can operate: buttons, inputs, choice chips, the index toggle, icon wells and the scale bar. Content never sits in a raised panel. Motion follows construction order: a rule draws, strokes draw themselves, then content settles onto them.

Numbers on these sheets are measured live in the visitor's browser (page weight, ready time, contrast, motion preference, drawing scale) and are never hard-coded claims. The world rejects the dark-SaaS-agency hero with neon gradient and logo wall.
keyCharacteristics: Vellum ground, graphite ink, blueline construction, one cobalt.
Hierarchy by line weight (1px hairline, 2px section head), never by enclosure.
One variable face, Archivo, swung across its width axis.
Lines draw, then content settles; full reduced-motion and no-JS fallbacks.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only saturated colour. It means "act here" or "this is the blueprint"; it is never decoration on a vellum sheet.

rules.name: The Blueprint Text Rule
rules.body: Text on the cobalt field uses Blueprint White (#ffffff) or Blueprint Mist (#e3e7ff), never Blueprint Line (#c9d2ff). The blueprint grid lightens the field, and #c9d2ff measured 4.41:1 there. Blueprint Line is for lines only.

rules.name: The Blueline Rule
rules.body: Non-Photo Blue is decorative only: construction grids and construction strokes. It never carries text, icons, borders of controls, or state.

rules.name: The Measured Edge Rule
rules.body: Text inputs rest on a #767a72 border (3:1 non-text contrast). Do not lighten it toward the hairline grey.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy changes width before it changes weight: titles widen (106-125%), annotation narrows (72%), prose stays at 100%. Never introduce a second family.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Condensed uppercase labels annotate a drawing: they name a sheet, a field, a stage or a measured value. They are not decorative eyebrows stacked over section headlines.

rules.name: The Line Not Box Rule
rules.body: A section or group boundary is a drawn line (1px graphite, 1px hairline, or a 2px graphite head rule), not a box, card or tinted panel.

rules.name: The Tools Only Rule
rules.body: Extrusion belongs to things you operate. Content, rows, figures and text never get a neumorphic shadow.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Pressing a tool swaps raise for inset and moves it 1px down. Focus is never shown by shadow alone: it is a 2px cobalt outline (white on cobalt).

dos: Do separate sections and items with drawn lines: 2px graphite head rules, 1px hairlines.
Do keep cobalt for action, focus, measured keys and the blueprint field.
Do use #ffffff or #e3e7ff for any text on the cobalt field.
Do widen Archivo for titles and condense it for uppercase annotation; prose stays at normal width.
Do keep neumorphic extrusion on tools: buttons, inputs, chips, the index toggle, wells and the scale bar.
Do show focus as a 2px cobalt outline (white on cobalt), never as a shadow change alone.
Do measure every displayed number live in the browser and label it as measured.
Do reveal in construction order: rule draws, strokes draw, then content settles, animating only transform and opacity.
Do keep content visible by default; motion applies only once JavaScript confirms it is running and reduced motion is not requested.
donts: Don't set text in #c9d2ff on the cobalt field; it measured 4.41:1 over the blueprint grid.
Don't use Non-Photo Blue (#8fb3d9) for text, icons, control borders or state.
Don't lighten the input resting border below #767a72.
Don't use clip-path in a reveal state on an element watched by IntersectionObserver; an element clipped to zero area is never reported and stays hidden.
Don't animate letter-spacing, width or other layout properties in reveals.
Don't hard-code performance, contrast or result figures as claims.
Don't put content in raised cards, tinted panels or boxes.
Don't introduce a second saturated colour, a second typeface, or a dark neon-gradient hero.
Don't stack condensed uppercase eyebrows over section headlines.
